subject: SEND - New notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} - ${notification.iun}
body1: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>Your company has received a notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} on SEND - Servizio Notifiche Digitali with IUN Code ${notification.iun}.
body2: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>The company has up to 120 days from the completion date of the notification to access the documents. The deadline for payment, if required, and for any appeals is indicated in the documents.
body3: A notification is a legally-binding communication consisting of a notice of receipt and one or more documents.
perfection: If you access the communication within 5 days of this email being sent, you will avoid registered post and any associated costs.
read_more: SEND is a tool that makes the sending of notifications by the Public Administration safer, more efficient and cheaper. Find out more
footer: You are receiving this communication because you entered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your email address<#else>the company email address among the courtesy contact details of SEND. To change your contact details or add new ones, go to your contact details.
